full_judgment:
2. The prosecution case having gradually developed in course of investigation, the facts leading to the prosecution of the 3 accused are set out below in chronological order. 

 4. S.I. Mofizuddin recorded the FIR and at 5 P.M. he held inquest on the dead body which was identified to him by parents and an other Tasimuddin, seized the Paijama, Kamij, Orna and hair, prepared sketch-map and sent the dead body to morgue for post mortem examination. He made over the case to S.I. Mohan Kumar on 18.8.77, S.I. Mshan Kumar received the case on 19.8.77, visited the P.O. examined some witnesses and arrested accused A. Rashid from village Kathali under Jaldhaka P.S. on 23.8.77 and forwarded the accused to Court on 24.8.77. He made over the case to Achinta Kumar Chowdhury, C.I. of Police, Gaibandha on 3.9.77. Mr. Achinta Kumar Chowdhury received the case on 3.9.77. In the meantime one Amjad Hossain who was an Assistant Teacher of the same school made a petition to the Headmaster on 30.8.77 saying that on the date of occurrence that is, on 8.8.77, the accused Abdur Rashid had confessed to him that he along with two other accused had committed rape on Rina in that morning. On his petition there was a resolution of the Executive Committee in a meeting held on 31.8.77. The Headmaster of the school forwarded the petition of Amjad Hossain along with a copy of the resolution to the O/C., Gobindaganj P.S. on 31.8.77. Mr. Achinta Kumar Chowdhury then examined Amjad Hossain on 3-9-77 and on that date he made a prayer to the Magistrate for taking remand of accused Abdur Rashid for further interrogation. He forwarded the accused to it doctor of Palasabari Government Thana Dispensary on 5.9.77 for examining the ecar marks on the right and left thumb of accused "Abdur Rashid as according to the said accused confession before Amjad Hossain he had said that Rani had bitten his thumbs while she was attacked by the accused. On 6.9.77 accused Abdur Rashid was produced before a 1st Class Magistrate for recording his confession. The Magistrate recorded his confession wherein he confessed that the along with other two co-accused committed rape on Rina on 8.8.77. After/ the Investigation all the 3-accused were charge-sheeted. All of them were charged u/s. 376 and 302/34 ofthe Penal Code 

 5. All the accused pleaded not guilty. Their case is that she fled away with some miscreants who ii1led her. There was no occurrence at the time, place and manner as was said by the prosecution and none of the accused was involved and they have been falsely implicated. It was further pleaded that the accused did not make any confession to Amjad Hossain nor did he make any voluntary confession before the Magistrate and the said confession was extracted from him by the police after torture. 

 7. There was no denial that Rina was killed and her dead body was found in the sugar cane field which was identified by her parents as well as others. The defence also admitted that Rina was killed and they only pleaded that she was killed by some miscreants and none of the accused was involved. Regarding the manner or the occurrence the defence suggested that she was killed in a different manner in the way or the usual defence suggestion that the time, place and the manner or occurrence was different. Upon consideration or all the evidence on record it is proved conclusively that Rina was killed in the sugar cine field ill the morning of 8.8.77 after forcibly lifting her on her way to the Headmaster's place where she was going for having private coaching.
